adaptations: Original skill, written clean-room for this repository's Cookbook section — not imported from upstream. The text, mapping and checklist are original work derived from the xDesign export format's JSON Schema and from public Telegram Bot API knowledge; no sentences, tables or lists were copied from the tool's guide, docs or README. source.commit records the xDesign HEAD the format was read from; the skill's own history is this repo's history. Upstream ships without a licence file at draft time (author states MIT is intended), so nothing of the tool's is reproduced here.
description: Build a working Telegram bot from an xDesign export zip: read spec.json as the source of truth, turn its steps into a state machine, and implement it on Cloudflare Workers or any webhook bot stack.
name: xdesign-export-builder
title: xDesign Export Builder
why: The design half of bot building had no skill: designers can now draw a bot in xDesign's no-code editor and an agent can implement it faithfully from the export, step for step, without re-deciding anything — the first skill that treats a bot design file as a build contract.
